note: A template of a working ingress Organization App.

params.label: ThreatConnect Owner
params.name: tc_owner
params.note: The destination Owner in the ThreatConnect Platform.

params.label: Initial Run (newest->oldest)
params.name: initial_run
params.note: When enabled, this execution imports records starting from the most recent timestamps and paginates older within the execution.

params.label: Initial Run Batch Limit (pages)
params.name: batch_limit
params.note: Maximum number of pages (~10,000 records per page) to process during initial_run.

params.label: Last Run (since date)
params.name: since_date
params.note: Used only when Initial Run is off. Records with timestamp after this date will be imported (ISO datetime or date, e.g. 2025-01-15T00:00:00Z or 2025-01-15). Optional; if empty, a single batch of newest records is fetched.
